narrationTexts: Confirmed: only the 3 rows with both a discount and a tax fail, in `orderTotal`. It taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**All 625 tests pass now.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the pre-discount amount. Tax should apply after the discount.

Fixed it to tax the discounted total. The 3 failures were rows where both a discount and a tax were non-zero, which is why most of the suite looked green already.
